name: The Surfeit
source:
Asher Ryouku arrives in Dalhot City, seemingly out of nowhere. He is quickly captured and incarcerated for being a 'cursed', which is a person who can use elemental abilities.

Before being executed, Asher meets Elyssia Elronde who pardons him after he claims to be the heir to the throne of a long destroyed city. Elyssia is intrigued by Asher and offers to guide the lost man back home.

Both Asher and Elyssia have hidden motives and powers which are not only hidden to each other, but to themselves as well.

Their journey to the other side of the planet is anything but uneventful and they soon realize that something is not right.

The Surfeit is an Adult Science Fiction Drama. It is a hybrid novel, which is a mix of a visual novel and audio drama. It is fully voiced and instead of choosing how the story goes, you choose how it will unfold.

[Edited from [url=https://surfeit.itch.io/the-surfeit]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿舍尔·流空不知从何而来，抵达达尔霍特城。他很快因“诅咒者”身份被捕入狱——诅咒者是能够使用元素能力的人。

在被处决前，阿舍尔遇见伊莉希娅·艾隆德。他声称自己是早已毁灭城市的王位继承人，伊莉希娅因此赦免他，并提出带这名迷路的男人回家。

阿舍尔与伊莉希娅都有隐藏的动机与力量，这些秘密不仅彼此不知，连他们自己也不了解。

两人前往星球另一侧的旅程绝不平静，他们很快意识到事情不对劲。

《过剩》是一部成人科幻剧情作品，也是一部结合视觉小说与广播剧的混合小说。全程配音，玩家不是选择故事走向，而是选择故事如何展开。

[据[url=https://surfeit.itch.io/the-surfeit]itch.io[/url]内容编辑]
